postconditions.expression: all(x in a for x in b)
postconditions.description: Every element in b must be present in a.

postconditions.expression: all(b.count(x) == a.count(x) for x in set(b))
postconditions.description: Each element in b must occur the same number of times as in a.

postconditions.expression: any(True for _ in range(len(b)) if all(b[i] >= a[i] for i in range(len(b))))
postconditions.description: There must be at least one way to transform b into a by halving or doubling elements, starting from the smallest element and moving to the largest.
